pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit high-frequency serration along the edges, characterized by sharp pixel gradients that create a jagged, star-like appearance. Patch area varies, appearing smaller and more angular along the dorsal ridge and transitioning to larger irregular polygons on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative space forms a continuous interconnected graph. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Corridor thickness is generally uniform across the visible field, with minor pixel narrowing at several intersection nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal ridge displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background, consisting of short, dark vertical hair fibers forming a dense, continuous profile.
